tests.description: External-metadata journey, mapped to the local CLI build over test/fixtures/external-metadata.

steps.description: A whole-corpus run over the external-metadata fixture merges the manifest, reports the manifest line for a bad value, and files a collision finding (exit 1).
The owned-key finding names the manifest and the collection it belongs to.

runShell.stdio: is owned by manifest docs-meta.yaml (collection pages)

steps.description: A manifest entry naming a page the run did not load is exit 2 on a whole-corpus run.

runShell.stdio: which this run did not load

steps.description: A write to a manifest-owned key lands in the manifest, and the change names it.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query -c test/fixtures/external-metadata/manni.config.yaml --dry-run "UPDATE docs SET jira = 'PLAT-1' WHERE _path = 'docs/auth.md'"

steps.description: A field-joined manifest files a duplicate finding on both pages sharing one id (exit 1).
A field entry no page carries is exit 2 on a whole-corpus run.
An UPDATE of the join field on a matched document is refused (exit 2).

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query -c test/fixtures/external-metadata-join/manni.config.yaml --dry-run "UPDATE docs SET id = 'other' WHERE _path = 'docs/auth.md'"
